title: She Turned a Warning into an Arrest
description:
A child custody disagreement set off a domino effect making sure that this mom lands in jail. Dispatch informed the officer that the female had been evicted from her residence at least a week ago and was in violation of a trespassing order by being in that location. Another officer arrived on the scene to make this screeching idiot get out of her car. A concerned neighbour also shed light on the incident agreeing with the father’s complaint that the female did not have enough resources at her house to support a child. The female was charged with resisting arrest and trespassing. Youtube thinks you’ll love the video on screen, click to watch now.
